en.t: Was it cheerfulness? ... Of course it was ...

units.source_text: 一切都像在填写等间隔的方格纸空当……

en.t: Everything was like filling in the blanks on evenly spaced graph paper ...

units.source_text: 呼吸也好，时间也好，屋子也好，女人也好……

en.t: Breathing, time, the room, the woman ... all of it ...

units.source_text: 这就是麦比乌斯圈所说的一般性欲吧？

en.t: This must be what the Mobius strip calls general sexual desire, right?

units.source_text: 如果是的话，这肥硕屁股的周围……

en.t: If so, then around these plump buttocks ...

units.source_text: 和街上拾到栗子刺球的那种“欲求不满”，是无法比较的……

en.t: it cannot be compared with that sort of "frustrated desire" like picking up a chestnut burr in the street ...
